notes: The same vendor_entity_id 'RES-12345' arrives via SevenRooms and (in a separate flow) the OpenTable adapter for the same operator. The framework's idempotency UNIQUE on (vendor_id, operator_id, vendor_entity_id, vendor_modified_at) places these in disjoint namespaces — the SevenRooms write does NOT collide with the OpenTable write because vendor_id differs. Conversely, a forged second SevenRooms delivery carrying the same (vendor_id='sevenrooms', operator_id, vendor_entity_id, vendor_modified_at) MUST short-circuit at the gateway (writeReservationFact returns false) without overwriting the canonical fact. Phase 2 harness asserts: two canonical_reservation_fact rows exist (one per real vendor), and a replay of the SevenRooms payload increments the idempotency-hit counter without changing fact-row state.
